hypotheses.reasoning: External IdP token endpoint got slow (4s, then 7.7s) and then hung until the 30s timeout. auth-svc calls to it stalled, so account-svc's issueToken calls also timed out. That filled the auth-svc connection pool (50/50), which led to checkout timeouts and the 503s at edge-proxy.
The IdP is a third party and may be degraded, but it shows up as hangs, not fast errors.

verdict.recommendedAction: Escalate to the IdP provider. Lower the auth-svc timeout on IdP calls well below 30s and add a circuit breaker, or fail fast, so the account-svc pool to auth-svc stops filling up.
